Онлайн‑лаборатория, где анализы дешевле: An online lab where tests cost up to 50% less and AI explains the results
Lab4U работает с 2012 года: своя лаборат: Lab4U has been running since 2012: its own laboratory plus a network of partner medical centers in 117 cities. Patients order and pay for tests online, give samples at the nearest center, and the tubes travel to the Lab4U lab. No clinics of its own means lower prices. Results arrive in the personal account and the app
Меня позвали сделать приложение 2.0 — пр: I was brought in to build app 2.0 — the old one was clumsy and dated. Then I built a design system from scratch, one for web and app, and took on the whole product. I'm the only designer in the company: I plan the work with the product manager and settle a lot directly with the developers
